profiles.name: Pochi
profiles.speaker: Cammy_JP
profiles.rationale: Cammy's bright child voice fits the small, eager dog girl; short reactions avoid adult delivery.

profiles.name: Shesta
profiles.speaker: Lynette_JP
profiles.rationale: Lynette's cool military register suits a controlled, predatory vampire combatant.

profiles.name: Gigi
profiles.speaker: Mana_JP
profiles.rationale: Mana's energetic young-adult delivery matches Gigi's lively electrical counterattacks.

profiles.name: Kamuro & Kitsu
profiles.speaker: Aria_JP
profiles.rationale: Aria's child voice and alternate short takes make the fox-girl pair sound quick and playful rather than mature.

profiles.name: Fleesia
profiles.speaker: Felicity_JP
profiles.rationale: Felicity's soft, restrained tone fits a flower spirit whose threat is pollen and trance rather than brute force.

profiles.name: Sofia
profiles.speaker: Lara_JP
profiles.rationale: Lara's calm healer voice is the closest persona match for Sofia's white-magic role.

profiles.name: Miyabi
profiles.speaker: Yue_JP
profiles.rationale: Yue's lively Japanese cadence and forceful short cry fit Miyabi's agile wild-hair fighting style.

profiles.name: Eater
profiles.speaker: Sabrina_JP
profiles.rationale: Sabrina's older, rougher register gives the carnivorous plant a weightier identity than the child voices.

profiles.name: Hild
profiles.speaker: Lynette_JP
profiles.rationale: A second, sharper Lynette set reinforces Hild's disciplined machine-soldier identity without reusing Shesta's clips.

profiles.name: Chrome & Frederica
profiles.speaker: Alicia_JP
profiles.rationale: Alicia's theatrical occult delivery supports the pair's experimental reassembly magic.

profiles.name: Shizuku
profiles.speaker: Tanya_JP
profiles.rationale: Tanya's weapon-obsessed confidence fits Shizuku's direct, heavy melee presence.

profiles.name: Regina
profiles.speaker: Mei_JP
profiles.rationale: Mei's archaic warrior diction and explicit blade challenge are a direct fit for Regina's swordsmanship.

profiles.name: Maiden
profiles.speaker: Melody_JP
profiles.rationale: Melody's witchlike, sing-song voice fits Maiden's nightmare and sleep magic.

profiles.name: Seraphy
profiles.speaker: Mist_JP
profiles.rationale: Mist's airy, slightly unusual delivery fits Seraphy's soft aquatic form and sleep-toxin theme.

profiles.name: Lisa
profiles.speaker: Tabatha_JP
profiles.rationale: Tabatha's composed, observant voice supports Lisa's controlled time-bending role.

profiles.name: Tama
profiles.speaker: Aria_JP
profiles.rationale: Aria's second, more assertive child set fits the small cat girl's playful bravado.

profiles.name: Maya
profiles.speaker: Alicia_JP
profiles.rationale: Alicia's second mystical set suits Maya's thread-of-time ranged magic; incantation-like takes are reserved for firing.

profiles.name: Matis
profiles.speaker: Tabatha_JP
profiles.rationale: Tabatha's reserved second set fits Matis's quiet blade style and keeps her distinct from Lisa.

profiles.name: Ooma
profiles.speaker: Lady Ann_JP
profiles.rationale: Lady Ann's mature, grounded voice supplies the weight needed for Ooma's large deep-sea body.

profiles.name: Jessie
profiles.speaker: Tanya_JP
profiles.rationale: Tanya's second weapon-focused set matches Jessie's martial, projectile-heavy battlefield role.

profiles.name: Aria
profiles.speaker: Cecilia_JP
profiles.rationale: Cecilia's gentle youthful voice complements Aria's forest and flower identity.

profiles.name: Carmilla
profiles.speaker: Bianca_JP
profiles.rationale: Bianca's haughty aristocratic voice is the strongest social and tonal match for the vampire noble Carmilla.

profiles.name: Giga
profiles.speaker: Natalie_JP
profiles.rationale: Natalie's firm adult register and scolding intensity give Giga authority without a childlike mismatch.

profiles.name: Lucretia
profiles.speaker: Rosetta_JP
profiles.rationale: Rosetta's confident young-adult voice suits a proud airborne queen without sounding as childlike as Cupi.

profiles.name: Cupi
profiles.speaker: Cammy_JP
profiles.rationale: Cammy's assertive second set keeps the small cupid youthful while making her ranged attack read clearly.

profiles.name: Sphinx
profiles.speaker: Natalie_JP
profiles.rationale: Natalie's second authoritative set fits Sphinx's royal, judgmental presence and remains distinct from Giga's clips.

profiles.name: Lucifina-chan
profiles.speaker: Serena_JP
profiles.rationale: Serena's bright child voice matches Lucifina-chan's deliberately small angel form.

profiles.name: Spider Princess
profiles.speaker: Rosetta_JP
profiles.rationale: Rosetta's sharper second set fits the calculating spider noble; no Lucretia clips are reused.

profiles.name: Emily
profiles.speaker: Mana_JP
profiles.rationale: Mana's upbeat second set matches Emily's cheerful stage presence and sparkle motif.

profiles.name: Sylph
profiles.speaker: Yue_JP
profiles.rationale: Yue's quick, light second set gives the fastest spirit a lively airborne identity distinct from Miyabi.

profiles.name: Gnome
profiles.speaker: Mei_JP
profiles.rationale: Mei's second stoic warrior set matches the earth spirit's compact, defensive toughness.

profiles.name: Undine
profiles.speaker: Lara_JP
profiles.rationale: Lara's second healer set is a direct match for Undine's restorative water role.

profiles.name: Salamander
profiles.speaker: Melody_JP
profiles.rationale: Melody's sharper second witch set gives the fire spirit energy without duplicating Maiden's reactions.

profiles.name: Sonya (commander)
profiles.speaker: Marian_JP
profiles.rationale: Marian's dedicated battle set gives Sonya a firm young-adult voice. Short clips carry reactions, medium clips carry movement and attacks, and the longest battle line is reserved for defeat.
